frontMatter.title: 💘 Love at First Smash!
frontMatter.summary: Join us for Thursday Club Night to enjoy some badminton and get ready for Valentine's Day. Watch Navan 'B' vs. Skryne 'B' in a thrilling match or play casual games on available courts.

prev.title: Wednesday Club Night: Badminton Excitement!
prev.summary: Join us for an exciting Wednesday Club Night where anything can happen on the badminton court. Matches, court availability, and young talent on display!
